column1: Purpose: Track your daily partnership outreach volume across every channel.
1. Fill in the Date for each day.
2. Fill in Emails Sent, Calls Made, LinkedIn DMs Sent, Twitter/X DMs Sent, and Instagram DMs Sent for that day.
3. Replace "Other Outreach Sent #1" with the actual platform name if you use another channel, or remove the column entirely if you don't need it.
5. Fill in Notes if anything is worth flagging.
